answer_so: BajGo waa app-ka Bajaajta ee Garoowe ee safarka iyo dirista alaabta. Ku dalbo Bajaaj ama dir xirmo dhowr taabasho, arag lacagta ka hor intaadan bixin, oo si toos ah ula soco darawalkaaga.
answer_en: BajGo is Garowe's on-demand Bajaaj app for rides and deliveries. Book a Bajaaj or send a parcel in a few taps, see your fare before you go, and track your driver live.

answer_so: Hadda BajGo wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa Garoowe oo keliya. Aagga adeegga waxaad ka arki kartaa bogga "Meelaha aan ka shaqeyno". Wuu ballaaran doonaa marka darawallo badan nagu soo biiraan.
answer_en: BajGo currently works in Garowe only. You can see the service area on the "Service coverage" page. It will grow as more drivers join.

answer_so: App-ku wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa Soomaali iyo Ingiriisi. Soomaali ayaa ah luqadda ugu horreysa; luqadda waxaad ka beddeli kartaa dejinta.
question_en: Which languages does the app support?
answer_en: The app works in Somali and English. Somali is the default; you can change the language in settings.

answer_so: Fur app-ka, dooro meesha lagaa qaadayo iyo meesha aad u socoto, arag qiimaha, kadibna xaqiiji. Darawalka ugu dhow ayaa helaya codsigaaga; magaciisa, koodhka gaariga iyo meesha uu joogo ayaad arki doontaa.
question_en: How do I book a Bajaaj?
answer_en: Open the app, choose your pickup and destination, see the fare, then confirm. The nearest driver receives your request; you will see their name, fleet code and live location.

question_so: Cinwaan sax ah ma hayo. Maxaan sameeyaa?
answer_so: Dhib ma leh. Biinka khariidadda ka dhig meesha aad joogto oo qor calaamad caan ah oo u dhow, sida masjid, dukaan ama iskuul. Darawalku wuu arki doonaa.
question_en: I don't have an exact address. What do I do?
answer_en: No problem. Drop the map pin where you are and add a nearby landmark, such as a mosque, shop or school. The driver will see it.

answer_so: Haa, waxaad joojin kartaa ka hor inta safarku bilaaban. Siyaasadda lacag-celinta iyo joojinta ayaa sharxaysa marka khidmad joojin la adeegsado.
answer_en: Yes, you can cancel before the trip starts. The refund & cancellation policy explains when a cancellation fee applies.

answer_so: Xirmooyin, cunto, dukumeenti, dawo iyo alaabta suuqa ilaa 30 kg. Waxyaabaha mamnuuca ah waxaad ka arki kartaa bogga BajGo Delivery.
answer_en: Parcels, food, documents, medicine and shopping up to 30 kg. Prohibited items are listed on the BajGo Delivery page.

question_so: Sidee loo hubiyaa in xirmadu gaartay qofka saxda ah?
answer_so: Marka darawalku gaaro, qaatuhu wuxuu helayaa koodh 4-lambar ah oo fariin ah. Darawalku wuxuu geliyaa koodhka ka hor intuusan xirmada dhiibin.
question_en: How do you make sure the parcel reaches the right person?
answer_en: When the driver arrives, the recipient receives a 4-digit code by SMS. The driver enters the code before handing over the parcel.

answer_so: Qiimaha wuxuu ku salaysan yahay masaafada waddada. Qiimaha bilowga waa $0.50 kiiloomitirkii, ugu yaraan $1.00. Qiimaha saxda ah waxaad arkaysaa app-ka ka hor intaadan xaqiijin.
answer_en: The fare is based on road distance. Launch pricing is $0.50 per km with a $1.00 minimum. You see the exact fare in the app before you confirm.

answer_so: Lacag caddaan ah ayaa la bixin karaa. Lacag-bixinta mobaylka waxaa lagu dari doonaa marka ay diyaar noqoto; app-ku wuxuu muujinayaa hababka hadda shaqeynaya.
answer_en: You can pay in cash. Mobile money will be added when it is ready; the app shows the methods currently available.

question_so: Sidee u ogaadaa darawalka saxda ah?
answer_so: Darawal kasta wuxuu leeyahay koodh gaari oo BajGo ah, sida BG-0142, oo ku qoran Bajaajka iyo app-ka. Isku hubi magaca, koodhka iyo taarikada ka hor intaadan fuulin.
question_en: How do I know I have the right driver?
answer_en: Every driver has a BajGo fleet code, such as BG-0142, shown on the Bajaaj and in the app. Check the name, fleet code and plate before you get in.

question_so: Safarkayga ma la wadaagi karaa qof kale?
answer_so: Haa. App-ka dhexdiisa, taabo "Wadaag safarka" si aad qof aad ku kalsoon tahay ugu dirto xiriirin uu kula socdo safarkaaga.
question_en: Can I share my trip with someone?
answer_en: Yes. In the app, tap "Share trip" to send someone you trust a link that lets them follow your trip.

answer_so: Buuxi foomka isdiiwaangelinta ee boggan. Kooxdayada ayaa ku soo wici doonta si loo hubiyo aqoonsigaaga, shatigaaga iyo Bajaajkaaga. Marka la oggolaado, waxaad soo dejin app-ka darawalka oo bilaabi kartaa.
question_en: How do I become a BajGo driver?
answer_en: Fill in the registration form on this website. Our team will call you to check your ID, licence and Bajaaj. Once approved, you download the driver app and start.

answer_so: Lacagta caddaanka ah darawalku wuu qaataa isla markaaba. Qayb ka mid ah qiimaha (komishanka) waxaa loo xisaabiyaa BajGo; app-ka darawalka wuxuu muujinayaa dakhliga iyo komishanka safar kasta.
answer_en: Cash fares are kept by the driver straight away. A share of each fare (the commission) goes to BajGo; the driver app shows earnings and commission for every trip.

answer_so: Waxaad u baahan tahay lambar taleefan oo keliya. Koodh ayaa laguu soo dirayaa fariin ahaan; furaha sirta ah looma baahna.
answer_en: You only need a phone number. A code is sent to you by SMS; there is no password.

answer_so: Haa. App-ka dhexdiisa waxaad ka codsan kartaa tirtiridda akoonka, ama nagala soo xiriir info@baj-go.com.
answer_en: Yes. You can request account deletion inside the app, or contact us at info@baj-go.com.
